why: An `@content` block named for the drawing and holding one outside every icon, the first top-level node of the first template read; `a-drawing-in-a-content-block` stands in the last node of the last. `ngc` refuses the block (NG8026), and point 1 refuses it before point 2 reads the drawing as standing where the block is written: the foreign component puts what a block holds where its own render does. Read as an element by its name, the block was a second `<svg>` the text does not hold, and point 1 refused the template for a miscount instead.
